frontmatter.description: Design, build, redesign, polish, or review product UI with a product-specific visual direction and a high craft bar. Use for frontend pages, components, dashboards, forms, responsive web surfaces, design-system work, screenshot or Figma-driven implementation, UI cleanup, interaction and animation decisions, or whenever an interface risks looking generic, templated, or AI-generated. Skip for backend-only work or mechanical frontend changes that do not materially affect the user experience.
